title: Type narrowing and guards — concept map
intro: typeof, instanceof, in checks, discriminated unions, user-defined type predicates, assertion functions, control-flow analysis, and unknown-at-boundary validation — how TypeScript refines types through branches.

overviewDiagram.title: Narrowing learning path
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart LR
  A["typeof / in / instanceof"] --> B["Discriminated unions"]
  B --> C["x is T guards"]
  C --> D["asserts x is T"]
  D --> E["Control flow + never"]
  E --> F["API boundary unknown"]

conceptCards.title: Built-in guards
conceptCards.summary: typeof for primitives. instanceof for classes. in for union members. typeof null quirk.

conceptCards.title: Discriminated unions
conceptCards.summary: Literal tag per variant. switch narrows. never in default for exhaustiveness.

conceptCards.title: User-defined guards
conceptCards.summary: x is T return type. Runtime checks must be sound. filter with predicate narrows array.
conceptCards.example: function isUser(x: unknown): x is User

conceptCards.title: Assertion functions
conceptCards.summary: asserts x is T throws or narrows scope. Flat control flow at boundaries.
conceptCards.example: function assertUser(x: unknown): asserts x is User

conceptCards.title: Control flow analysis
conceptCards.summary: Narrowing through branches. Reset on reassignment. never vs void.

conceptCards.title: API boundary narrowing
conceptCards.summary: unknown at fetch/JSON. Zod or manual guards. Types erase on wire.
